HARD PRINCIPLE: every enforcement gate ships in 3 moves - Measure (report-only, count existing violations) -> Conform (debug/refactor/lint the existing repo to zero) -> Enforce (flip to blocking in CI + pre-commit). Never flip a blocking gate onto a non-conforming repo. Size the Conform effort FROM the measured count.

invisible_knowledge: RATCHET STRENGTH LADDER: executable(test/CI/constraint/txn) > structural(seam/type/schema) > configuration(tracked settings) > documentary(rule/runbook) > memory/chat(lost). Leave every ratchet as high as it goes; tag each invariant (never loosened) vs opinion (revise freely); route each lesson to ONE home + prune the stale copy. (Thalon AGENTS.md:25; Eamos mirrors it as docs/parallel-agents/ratchet-philosophy.md.) This is WHY graphify (documentary) yields to structural tests, and WHY the handoff-lint must move from a local hook to CI (executable).

The handoff drifted to 482 lines DESPITE having a linter because the linter runs only in a local untracked .git/hooks/pre-commit, non-strict, only when CURRENT.md is staged - never in CI/worktree-lane/Codex session. Root cause = wiring + schema (append-only ledgers), NOT thresholds. Thalon's CURRENT.md is 45 lines because it has ZERO append surfaces (overwrite-whole-file each wrap; history in git).

Contract-window invariant: freeze the schema+contract BEFORE lanes fork; additive-only (never rename/remove/tighten outside a window); a mid-sprint contract edit = re-plan, not an ad-hoc edit. Every invariant is extended as an executable test IN THE SAME change (Thalon extends tenant-id.test.ts / events-coverage.test.ts in the window).

grep-guard must scan TRACKED files only (git grep - CI sees only committed files) AND assemble forbidden tokens from fragments ('ea'+'mos') so the guard passes its own scan. Wire as BOTH pre-commit (exit-code must gate the commit - Swordfish added theirs only after a name leaked because the guard's exit code never gated) AND a required CI check.

Never npm install inside a worktree - npm v7+ deletes the linked/junctioned node_modules and forks the lane's dependency tree. preinstall guard detects a worktree via .git being a FILE (not a dir). Installs run in the MAIN checkout only; the symlink/junction makes them visible to every lane.

Gate rollout is 3-move (Measure -> Conform -> Enforce). Flipping a blocking gate onto a non-conforming repo red-walls every PR - the ruff/black + prod-build gates especially need a Conform pass sized from the measured violation count first.

CI required-check name must stay STABLE across shard/re-org (branch protection references it by name); use an aggregate job (needs:[...] + if: always() + explicit success assert) so a skipped required check cannot silently pass.
